import sys
from collections import deque

class Point:
    def __init__(self, r=0, c=0):
        self.r = r
        self.c = c

dr = [-1, 0, 0, 1]
dc = [0, -1, 1, 0]

N, T = 0, 0
B = [['#']*12 for _ in range(12)]
B1 = [['#']*12 for _ in range(12)]
B2 = [['#']*12 for _ in range(12)]
D1 = [[-1]*12 for _ in range(12)]
D2 = [[-1]*12 for _ in range(12)]

def fillDist1(start):
    for i in range(12):
        for j in range(12):
            D1[i][j] = -1
    D1[start.r][start.c] = 0
    q = deque()
    q.append(start)
    while q:
        p = q.popleft()
        for k in range(4):
            np = Point(p.r + dr[k], p.c + dc[k])
            if B[np.r][np.c] != '.':
                continue
            if D1[np.r][np.c] < 0:
                D1[np.r][np.c] = D1[p.r][p.c] + 1
                q.append(np)

def fillDist2(start):
    for i in range(12):
        for j in range(12):
            D2[i][j] = -1
    D2[start.r][start.c] = 0
    q = deque()
    q.append(start)
    while q:
        p = q.popleft()
        if D1[p.r][p.c] >= 0 and D2[p.r][p.c] >= D1[p.r][p.c]:
            continue
        for k in range(4):
            np = Point(p.r + dr[k], p.c + dc[k])
            if B[np.r][np.c] != '.':
                continue
            if D2[np.r][np.c] < 0:
                if D1[np.r][np.c] >= 0 and D1[np.r][np.c] < D2[p.r][p.c] + 1:
                    continue
                D2[np.r][np.c] = D2[p.r][p.c] + 1
                q.append(np)

class MF:
    def __init__(self, size):
        self.n = size
        self.cap = [[0]*size for _ in range(size)]
        self.flow = [[0]*size for _ in range(size)]
        self.parent = [-1]*size
        self.level = [-1]*size

    def addEdge(self, u, v, c):
        self.cap[u][v] += c

    def bfs(self, s, t, p):
        for i in range(self.n):
            self.parent[i] = -1
            self.level[i] = -1
        self.level[s] = 0
        q = deque()
        q.append(s)
        while q:
            u = q.popleft()
            if u == t:
                minCap = float('inf')
                v = t
                while v != s:
                    u2 = self.parent[v]
                    minCap = min(minCap, self.cap[u2][v] - self.flow[u2][v])
                    v = u2
                p.clear()
                v = t
                while v != s:
                    p.append(v)
                    v = self.parent[v]
                p.append(s)
                p.reverse()
                return minCap
            for v in range(self.n):
                if self.parent[v] < 0 and self.cap[u][v] - self.flow[u][v] > 0:
                    self.parent[v] = u
                    self.level[v] = self.level[u] + 1
                    q.append(v)
        return 0

    def maxFlow(self, s, t):
        total = 0
        p = []
        while True:
            push = self.bfs(s, t, p)
            if push == 0:
                break
            for i in range(len(p) - 1):
                u = p[i]
                v = p[i + 1]
                self.flow[u][v] += push
                self.flow[v][u] -= push
            total += push
        return total

def main():
    global N, T, B, B1, B2, D1, D2
    input = sys.stdin.read().splitlines()
    N, T = map(int, input[0].split())
    line_idx = 1
    for i in range(12):
        for j in range(12):
            B1[i][j] = '#'
            B2[i][j] = '#'
            B[i][j] = '#'
    for r in range(1, N+1):
        row_str = input[line_idx]
        line_idx += 1
        for c in range(1, N+1):
            B1[r][c] = row_str[c-1]
        B1[r][N+1] = '#'
    for r in range(1, N+1):
        row_str = input[line_idx]
        line_idx += 1
        for c in range(1, N+1):
            B2[r][c] = row_str[c-1]
        B2[r][N+1] = '#'
    for r in range(1, N+1):
        for c in range(1, N+1):
            B[r][c] = '#'
    scientists = []
    capsules = []
    z = Point()
    for r in range(1, N+1):
        for c in range(1, N+1):
            ch1 = B1[r][c]
            ch2 = B2[r][c]
            if ch1.isdigit():
                if ch1 > '0':
                    scientists.append(Point(r, c))
                B[r][c] = '.'
            elif ch1 == 'Z':
                z = Point(r, c)
                B[r][c] = '.'
            if ch2.isdigit() and ch2 > '0':
                capsules.append(Point(r, c))
    fillDist1(z)
    s = 0
    t_node = len(scientists) + len(capsules) + 1
    mf = MF(t_node + 1)
    for i, sc in enumerate(scientists):
        mf.addEdge(s, i + 1, int(B1[sc.r][sc.c]))
    for j, cap in enumerate(capsules):
        mf.addEdge(len(scientists) + j + 1, t_node, int(B2[cap.r][cap.c]))
    for i, sc in enumerate(scientists):
        fillDist2(sc)
        for j, cap in enumerate(capsules):
            if D2[cap.r][cap.c] >= 0 and D2[cap.r][cap.c] <= T:
                mf.addEdge(i + 1, len(scientists) + j + 1, float('inf'))
    res = mf.maxFlow(s, t_node)
    print(res)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
